author: PI/OpenAI
selection: Same five pairs, second template fixed before running (continent and currency), for a rate of the frozen all-position J coordinate swap chosen on Sweden/Japan (2739).

cases.name: China_to_Egypt
cases.user_content: Which continent is the country with the city of Shanghai on, and what is that country's three-letter currency code? Reply only as '<continent>; <currency code>'.

cases.name: Egypt_to_China
cases.user_content: Which continent is the country with the city of Alexandria on, and what is that country's three-letter currency code? Reply only as '<continent>; <currency code>'.

cases.name: arithmetic_control
cases.user_content: Someone from Shanghai asks: what is 2 + 2, and is that sum odd or even? Reply only as '<sum>; <odd or even>'.

evaluation.notes: Judge capital and currency from the full output; first-token probabilities are not full-name probabilities.
